title: Announcements
help: Send plain text email updates to your members.
subject: Subject
statusHelp: Include active, trial and frozen members by default. Choose at least one status.
programHelp: Leave all unchecked for all programs. Otherwise, include members in any selected program (up to 100).
audienceHelp: The count excludes opted-out members and duplicate or missing addresses. Eligibility is checked again when sending.
testHelp: The test goes only to your signed-in email address, with a test notice and an inactive unsubscribe footer.
testSent: Test sent to your email address. No members received it.
confirmHelp: Sending cannot be undone. Check the message and audience before confirming. The final audience can change if member details change.
noRecipients: No eligible members match this audience. Edit the filters before sending.
invalid: Enter a subject (up to 150 characters, one line), a message (up to 10,000 characters), and at least one member status.
previewError: The preview could not be prepared. Try again.
testError: The test could not be sent. Try again.
sendError: We could not confirm the result. Retry this same announcement here to avoid a duplicate send. Check history before starting another announcement.
sendRefused: The announcement was not accepted. Edit the message or audience, check your access and settings, then preview again.
retainedAttempt: This send may already have been accepted. Reopening this dialog here keeps the same message and retry. Check history before leaving this page.
no_origin: A canonical HTTPS gym address is not configured. Ask the owner to check the gym address in Settings and the install configuration before sending.
disabled: Member email is switched off. Enable member email in the Go-live section of Settings before sending.
no_smtp: Email is not set up for this gym. The owner sets up SMTP under Email, payments and backups in Settings.
programError: Programs could not be loaded. Retry to compose an announcement.
senderError: Sender names could not be loaded. Sender account IDs are shown instead.
noAccess: Only owners and admins can send announcements and view their history.
queued: Announcement accepted. Delivery progress appears in history.
